source.primary_table: Table 1 main properties of SmAPα1-21 derived peptides
source.methods: Sections 4.1 and 4.4 provide strain and MIC assay conditions
source.figure_crosscheck: Figure 1 and Section 2.2 corroborate H19R/H19A conidial growth inhibition at MIC values
source.supplementary_crosscheck: No local supplementary assets were present; absence was checked in packet extraction outputs and source/supplementary.

target.strain: SP1 grain isolate from San Pedro, Buenos Aires, Argentina

assay_conditions.method: 96-well F. graminearum conidia growth inhibition assay; OD595 read at 0, 19, 24, 43, and 48 h
assay_conditions.inoculum: 90 µL of 5 x 10^4 spores/mL plus 10 µL peptide solution
assay_conditions.medium: half-strength potato dextrose broth context, pH 5.5 noted for charge calculation
assay_conditions.replicates: triplicate MIC assay; time-to-kill treatments replicated twice where applicable
assay_conditions.statistics: one-way ANOVA with Tukey test for inhibition data

curation_notes: Rebuilt during worker-2 re-review from primary Table 1 instead of the earlier parser scaffold.
MIC is defined in the table footnote as the minimal peptide concentration that completely inhibits F. graminearum growth.
